title: Culthor the Gatekeeper
summary: Culthor grows more dangerous as his linked guards are removed.
overview: Culthor grows more dangerous as his linked guards are removed.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Choose the guard kill order deliberately and prepare tank cooldowns for the final guards.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The Firewatcher starts the encounter for a rogue at the required epic step after the four-part turn-in.
Culthor links to his guards when combat begins.
His maximum melee damage increases as the guard count falls from six to zero.

notes: Approval E299. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
